native.natural: First train world, correct home_city, EN/ZH, both policies; four actual greedy positions per run, four runs. Prefix-chain smoke only, NOT complete-reply accuracy or registered 24-case baseline.
native.fixtures: Separate fresh models, both policies, EN correct source. Four one-position fixtures: forced neural normal/supported/insufficient and disabled. Reader/factor output biases set for route coverage, content/uncertainty output matrices filled with deterministic nonzero normal noise std 0.001, seed 4013. These weights are NOT trained candidates, never saved or used as memory accuracy evidence.
native.backend: Fresh C reference and C continuous projection at every actual predicted prefix. Python reader and copy remain; no answer/prefix-bank fallback or KV history reuse.

cuda.selection: First train world, home_city, EN/ZH; correct, role_swap, value_swap, empty, ordinary_source, ordinary_empty. Twelve records, four pair kinds, two arms: sixteen comparisons. CPU and CUDA on the same GPU host use identical CPU-initialized weights.
cuda.precision: FP32; AMP and TF32 off; finite active gradients, same disconnected gradients, no optimizer or parameter mutation
cuda.provenance: Selected tensors exported from the verified full C package. Transfer a complete source snapshot into a fresh isolated server directory. Reuse output-head.npy ONLY after SHA256 verification; verify same 0.5B GGUF identity on server.

failure_policy: Retain every failure and denominator. No seed, tolerance or threshold search; a failure blocks training until diagnosed and separately revalidated.
